products.product_title: Serabit El-Khadim Bedouin Camp & 4x4 Desert Safari Adventure
products.short_description: Explore Serabit El-Khadim from Sharm El Sheikh, discover the Temple of Hathor and ancient turquoise mines, then enjoy Bedouin camping and stargazing under the Sinai stars.
products.product_description:
Discover the hidden beauty of Sinai on an unforgettable one-day adventure through the mountains, valleys, and ancient landscapes of Serabit El-Khadim. This experience combines an exciting 4x4 desert safari, ancient Egyptian history, mountain hiking, breathtaking scenery, and authentic Bedouin hospitality, taking you far away from the usual tourist routes.
Your adventure begins at approximately 9:00 AM at Abu Zenima Road, where you will meet your local team and board a 4x4 Jeep specially suited for the desert terrain. Leave the paved roads behind and begin an exciting journey through the rugged mountains, rocks, and valleys of Sinai. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you travel deeper into the desert, with spectacular views and opportunities to stop for photographs along the way.
At around 10:00 AM, arrive at Beit Barakat, a traditional Bedouin house and desert camp surrounded by the mountains of Sinai. Take a break from the journey and enjoy a delicious traditional Bedouin breakfast with freshly prepared Bedouin tea. Relax, meet your local hosts, and experience the peaceful atmosphere and warm hospitality of desert life before beginning the main adventure of the day.
Ancient Temple of Hathor
After breakfast, begin your journey toward the historic Temple of Hathor at Serabit El-Khadim.
The visit includes an approximately 45-minute hike through the mountains. Follow the ancient mountain paths as you climb toward the archaeological site, surrounded by spectacular desert scenery and panoramic views of the surrounding valleys and mountains.
At the summit, discover the ancient Temple of Hathor, one of the most fascinating archaeological sites in Sinai and a place closely associated with the ancient Egyptian turquoise-mining expeditions.
Spend approximately one hour exploring the temple and archaeological area with your guide. Discover the ancient remains, inscriptions, and traces of the activities that once took place in this remote mountain region. Standing among the ruins, surrounded by dramatic mountains and complete silence, offers a unique opportunity to experience ancient Egyptian history in its natural desert setting.
After completing your archaeological tour, begin your descent through the mountains and return to Beit Barakat.
Traditional Bedouin Lunch
After the hike, enjoy a traditional Bedouin lunch at approximately 2:00 PM at Beit Barakat. Relax, enjoy authentic local food, and take in the peaceful mountain surroundings before continuing your desert adventure.
4x4 Safari – Wadi Baba & Serabit El-Khadim
After lunch, get back into your 4x4 Jeep and continue exploring the remote landscapes of Sinai.
Travel through Wadi Baba, a spectacular desert valley surrounded by mountains and dramatic rock formations. Enjoy the scenery, take photographs, and experience the peaceful atmosphere of one of Sinai's remote valleys.
highlights: 4×4 Desert Adventure through the remote mountains of Sinai
Bedouin Experience at Beit Barakat
Visit the Ancient Temple of Hathor
Explore Serabit ElKhadim one of Sinai’s most fascinating ancient archaeological
Traditional Bedouin breakfast & lunch

products.product_title: Cairo: Private Guided Tour to Your Chosen Attraction
products.short_description: Explore Cairo on a private tour with a customizable itinerary. Visit the Giza Pyramids, the Sphinx, the Grand Egyptian Museum, the Citadel of Saladin, and the Mosque of Muhammad Ali.
products.product_description:
Enjoy a flexible tour of Cairo designed around what you want to see. We provide a private car and an expert tour guide; you decide which attraction, or attractions, you'd like to visit, whether it's the Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx, the Egyptian Museum, the Grand Egyptian Museum, the Citadel of Salah El-Din and the Mosque of Muhammad Ali, Khan El Khalili, or anywhere else you're interested in.

Your guide will be with you every step of the way, helping you decide the best order to visit places and sharing the history and stories behind each site engagingly. Entrance tickets to attractions are at your own expense and are paid directly by each visitor at the site.

The itinerary isn't fixed; you can change or add stops during the tour based on your time and interests, and your guide will help you adjust the plan on the go.
highlights: Explore Cairo on a private tour with a customizable itinerary
Visit the Giza Pyramids, the Sphinx, and the Grand Egyptian Museum
Discover the Citadel of Saladin and the Mosque of Muhammad Ali
Wander through the bustling Khan el-Khalili market
Learn about the city's history and culture from your guide

products.product_title: Luxor: Private Customizable Tour with Egyptologist Guide
products.short_description: Explore Luxor's ancient wonders on a private customizable tour with an Egyptologist guide. Choose your preferred sites, enjoy a horse carriage ride, and savor a local lunch.
products.product_description:
Embark on a full-day customized private tour through the timeless treasures of Luxor. Whether you're passionate about pharaohs, temples, or royal tombs, this flexible tour allows you to design your perfect day with the help of a professional Egyptologist guide.

Start your experience with pickup from your hotel or Luxor Airport, then travel in a private air-conditioned vehicle to explore the landmarks you choose. Such as Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, or Luxor Temple.

To add a special cultural touch, enjoy a free traditional horse carriage ride through the scenic streets of the city. You'll also stop for a local lunch at a handpicked restaurant and receive bottled water throughout the tour.

Entrance fees to the sites are not included by default, but you can easily select your preferred monuments as add-ons when booking.

Whether you're a first-time visitor or a returning explorer, this fully customized private tour offers insight, flexibility, and comfort, all in one unforgettable day in Luxor.
highlights: Discover Luxor's ancient wonders on a private customizable tour
Choose your preferred sites, from Karnak Temple to the Valley of the Kings
Enjoy a traditional horse carriage ride through the scenic streets of Luxor
Savor a local lunch at a handpicked restaurant and stay hydrated with water
Benefit from the insights of a professional Egyptologist guide

products.product_title: Private Customizable Day Tour to Alexandria from Cairo
products.short_description: Explore Alexandria on a private tour from Cairo with a guide and driver. Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, the Roman amphitheater of Kom El-Deka, and the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa.
products.product_description:
Your private guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo in the early morning and take you comfortably to Alexandria in a private, air-conditioned vehicle. The journey takes approximately 2.5 to 3 hours, allowing you to enjoy the scenic drive from Cairo to Egypt’s historic Mediterranean coast.

This is a fully private and customizable experience. The sightseeing program is flexible and can be changed according to your interests, preferred pace, and available time. You can follow the suggested itinerary below or choose to visit other attractions in Alexandria based on your preferences.

The suggested sightseeing includes the Qaitbay Citadel, a historic 15th-century fortress built on the site traditionally associated with the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria. Continue to the Roman Amphitheatre of Kom El-Deka, an important archaeological site, and explore the fascinating Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, which combine Egyptian, Greek, and Roman architectural influences.

Lunch Break: Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant, included in the tour. Bottled water and a soft drink are also provided during the tour.

You may also customize your tour by adding or replacing sightseeing stops, such as Montaza Palace and its gardens, Stanley Bridge, the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, the Alexandria Corniche, or other historical and cultural attractions according to your interests.

Please note that sightseeing visits and entrance tickets are not included in the tour price. The entrance fees depend on the attractions you choose to visit and are paid directly by the customer at each location. The tour price includes private transportation, a professional private guide in the language selected when booking, lunch, bottled water, and a soft drink.

At the end of your customized Alexandria experience, your private driver and guide will accompany you on the journey back to Cairo and drop you off at your hotel.
highlights: Explore Alexandria on a private tour from Cairo with a guide and driver
Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, built on the site of the Lighthouse of Alexandria
Discover the Roman amphitheater of Kom El-Deka & the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant in Alexandria
Customize your tour with optional stops at Montaza Palace or Stanley Bridge

products.product_title: Mount Moses, St. Catherine Monastery & Stargazing Adventure
products.short_description: Camp under the Sinai stars, enjoy a Bedouin dinner and stargazing, hike Mount Moses for sunrise, then visit St. Catherine’s Monastery and enjoy a traditional breakfast.
products.product_description:
Bedouin culture, stargazing, and one of Egypt’s most iconic spiritual landmarks.

Choose between a Private or Shared experience and spend an incredible night in the heart of the Sinai mountains. Enjoy a traditional Bedouin dinner at the campsite, followed by an amazing stargazing experience with a local guide who will introduce you to the stars, constellations, and fascinating stories of the night sky.

You can enjoy the stargazing experience either before starting the Mount Moses hike or, depending on the conditions and timing, from the mountain itself. Then, begin your hike up Mount Moses during the night and reach the summit in time to witness the breathtaking sunrise over the Sinai mountains.

During the experience, your guide will also share the stories and historical significance of the Prophet Elijah’s House and the Hanging Tree, giving you a deeper connection to the history, traditions, and legends of the area.

After descending, enjoy a well-deserved breakfast before visiting the historic St. Catherine’s Monastery, one of the world’s oldest continuously operating Christian monasteries and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

This experience is perfect for travelers looking for more than a traditional sightseeing tour — it combines adventure, nature, culture, astronomy, history, and a truly memorable night in Sinai.
highlights: Stargazing Under the Sinai Sky with an explanation of stars and constellations
Learn the Story of Prophet Elijah’s House & the Hanging Tree
Sunrise Over the Sinai Mountains
Visit St. Catherine’s Monastery and discover its fascinating history
Private or Shared Tour Options to suit your travel style

products.product_title: From Cairo: 4x4 Desert Safari, Waterfalls & Magic Lake
products.short_description: Escape Cairo for a full-day Fayoum adventure. Enjoy a thrilling 4x4 desert safari, visit Wadi El Rayan Waterfalls and Magic Lake, try sandboarding, and enjoy an authentic Egyptian countryside lunch.
products.product_description:
Escape the busy streets of Cairo and discover the natural beauty of Fayoum on a full-day adventure combining desert landscapes, exciting activities, local culture, and authentic Egyptian food.

Begin your experience with a comfortable pickup from your hotel in Cairo or Giza. Travel in an air-conditioned vehicle toward Fayoum Oasis, one of Egypt’s most beautiful natural destinations, where golden desert dunes meet peaceful lakes and dramatic rock formations.

Upon arrival, transfer to a 4x4 vehicle and begin an exciting desert safari across the sand dunes. Enjoy the changing landscapes as your experienced desert driver takes you through some of Fayoum’s most scenic areas.

Visit the Wadi El Rayan Protected Area and admire its famous waterfalls. All required entrance fees to the protected area are included, allowing you to enjoy the experience without unexpected additional charges.

Continue to the beautiful Magic Lake, surrounded by golden dunes and dramatic desert scenery. The lake is known for its changing colors throughout the day, depending on the sunlight and surrounding landscape.

Stop at Mudawara Mountain, one of Fayoum’s most impressive panoramic viewpoints. Take time to enjoy the scenery and capture memorable photographs overlooking the desert and nearby lakes.

Add more excitement to your adventure with a sandboarding experience on the soft desert dunes. No previous experience is required, making the activity suitable for beginners and adventure lovers.

After your desert activities, enjoy an authentic Egyptian countryside lunch prepared using traditional local cooking methods. Choose between slow-cooked chicken or slow-cooked duck, served with Egyptian rice, seasonal vegetables, fresh salads, traditional baladi bread, and local side dishes.

You may also personalize your experience with optional activities, including a horse-riding experience, a dune buggy ride, or an upgrade to a fresh seafood meal. Optional activities are subject to availability and can be selected during booking or arranged before the tour.

After lunch and some time to relax, travel back to Cairo or Giza with unforgettable memories and photographs from one of Egypt’s most beautiful natural destinations.
highlights: Experience an exciting 4x4 desert safari across Fayoum’s sand dunes.
Visit the famous waterfalls inside Wadi El Rayan Protected Area.
Discover the beautiful Magic Lake and its surrounding desert scenery.
Enjoy panoramic views and photo opportunities at Mudawara Mountain.
Try sandboarding on the soft desert dunes.

products.product_title: Hurghada: Luxor Valley of the Kings & Tutankhamun Tomb Trip
products.short_description: Discover ancient Luxor on a full-day tour. Visit the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and Karnak Temple with a professional guide. Optional: Tutankhamun’s Tomb or the Tomb of Ramses V and VI
products.product_description:
Full-Day Trip from Hurghada to Luxor

The trip starts early in the morning with pickup from the hotel in Hurghada by a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Guests then travel through the desert road toward Luxor. During the journey, there is a short rest stop of approximately 30 minutes, where guests can use the bathroom or have a light drink before continuing the drive to Luxor.

Upon arrival in Luxor, the tour guide will be waiting for the guests according to the language selected during booking. The tour begins with a visit to Karnak Temple, one of the largest and most important temple complexes in ancient Egypt. Guests will enjoy a guided explanation of the temple’s history, its massive columns, sacred halls, and impressive ancient architecture.

After visiting Karnak Temple, guests continue to the West Bank of Luxor. There are two options for crossing: guests may either continue by bus, or choose to cross by boat for an additional optional fee. If the boat option is selected, guests can enjoy a pleasant Nile boat trip for approximately 30 minutes.

After that, guests head to a local restaurant for lunch, then continue the tour toward the Valley of the Kings. On the way, there is a stop at the Colossi of Memnon for approximately 15 minutes, giving guests time to take photos and learn some historical information about the site.

At the Valley of the Kings, the package includes entrance to 3 tombs from the tombs open for visits. Guests also have the option, depending on their preference or pre-booked selection, to enter Tutankhamun’s Tomb or the Tomb of Ramses V and VI for an additional optional fee.

After finishing the visit to the Valley of the Kings, the tour continues toward the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. On the way, there is a rest stop of approximately 30 minutes at an alabaster or stone handicraft workshop, where guests are welcomed with a cold local drink. Guests will also have time to relax or use the bathroom.

The trip then continues to Hatshepsut Temple, a unique terraced temple set against the mountains and dedicated to one of the most famous queens in ancient Egyptian history.

At the end of the day, guests return comfortably to Hurghada by air-conditioned vehicle after enjoying a memorable day exploring the most important historical landmarks of Luxor.
highlights: Discover the Valley of the Kings, home to Egypt’s most powerful pharaohs
Visit the iconic Temple of Queen Hatshepsut carved into the cliffs of Luxor
Explore the massive Karnak Temple complex with its towering columns
Enjoy a comfortable full-day tour from Hurghada in a small group
Optional entry to Tutankhamun’s Tomb or Ramses V & VI Tomb

products.product_title: Hurghada: Cairo Day Trip with Pyramids, Museum & Quad Bike
products.short_description: Discover Cairo on a full-day trip from Hurghada, with travel by domestic flight or minivan depending on the option selected at booking.
products.product_description:
Enjoy a full-day trip from Hurghada to Cairo and explore Egypt’s most famous ancient landmarks. This tour is available with two transportation options: by domestic flight or by air-conditioned minivan/vehicle. The travel method depends on the option selected by the guest at the time of booking.

Your day starts with pickup from your hotel in Hurghada. If you select the flight option, you will be transferred to Hurghada Airport for a domestic flight to Cairo. If you select the minivan option, you will travel by road in an air-conditioned vehicle, with rest stops along the way.

Upon arrival in Cairo, meet your professional tour guide. The guide language will be based on the language option selected during booking. Start your sightseeing program at the famous Giza Plateau, home to the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, the Pyramid of Menkaure, and the Great Sphinx. Your guide will explain the history of the area and give you time for photos.

Entry to the Giza Plateau is included. Entry inside one of the pyramids is optional and available for an additional fee, depending on the guest’s preference and availability on the day.

Continue to your museum visit. Depending on the selected option and availability, guests may visit either the Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square or the Grand Egyptian Museum. The Egyptian Museum offers a classic collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts, while the Grand Egyptian Museum provides a modern museum experience with spacious galleries and updated displays.

Lunch is included at a local restaurant in Cairo. If time allows, an optional Nile boat trip may be offered for an additional fee. The program may also include short shopping stops at selected local shops, such as souvenir shops, perfume shops, papyrus galleries, or similar places. Shopping is completely optional.

At the end of the day, return to Hurghada by the transportation method selected at booking. Flight-option guests will transfer to Cairo Airport for the return flight to Hurghada, followed by hotel drop-off. Minivan-option guests will return by road to Hurghada, with arrival usually late in the evening or at night.

This tour is ideal for travelers who want to visit Cairo’s main highlights in one day, with the flexibility to choose between a faster flight option or a road-trip option by minivan.
highlights: Choose between travel by domestic flight or an air-conditioned minivan
Visit the Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx
Choose between the Grand Egyptian Museum or Egyptian Museum
Learn from a professional guide in the language selected at booking
Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Cairo

products.product_title: Hurghada: City Tour & Bazaar with Optional Sand Museum Visit
products.short_description: Discover Hurghada on a guided city tour featuring top landmarks and local culture. Explore vibrant bazaars and hidden gems, with the option to visit the unique Sand Museum for an added experience.
products.product_description:
Discover the real Hurghada on this guided city tour that combines culture, history, and local life. Start your experience with convenient hotel pickup in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle, then explore some of the city’s most iconic landmarks.

Visit the beautiful El Mina Mosque, admire the architecture of St. Shenouda Church, and experience the authentic atmosphere of the traditional fishing village. Continue to the lively Hurghada Marina promenade, where you can enjoy scenic views, take photos, and soak in the vibrant coastal vibe.

Stroll through local bazaars and markets, where you’ll find a variety of Egyptian products such as perfumes, spices, natural oils, and handmade souvenirs.

You can also choose to enhance your experience with an optional visit to the Sand Museum (Sand City), a unique open-air gallery featuring impressive sculptures inspired by ancient Egyptian history and famous global figures.

Throughout the tour, a friendly and knowledgeable guide will share insights into Hurghada’s culture and daily life, ensuring a comfortable and engaging experience.

For added comfort, optional upgrades such as lunch at a local restaurant or a relaxing shisha stop are available.
The client can choose between the all options
Whether you choose a shared or private option, this tour offers the perfect introduction to Hurghada beyond the beach.
highlights: Clients can choose Private or shared tour options
Visit the mosque, church, marina & traditional fishing village
Enjoy shopping time at bazaars and local spice shops
Special price for families or groups of 4+ guests
Includes hotel pickup and return in shared transportation

products.product_title: Hurghada to Cairo: Pyramids & Museum for First-Time Visitors
products.short_description: A beginner-friendly Cairo day trip by bus, designed especially for travelers visiting Egypt for the first time
products.product_description:
This full-day Cairo trip from Hurghada is designed for travelers visiting Egypt for the first time and looking for a clear, well-organized introduction to the country’s most iconic landmarks. The tour is operated by bus or coach with hotel pickup and drop-off in Hurghada.

Your journey starts late at night or very early in the morning, depending on your hotel location and the confirmed pickup schedule. Travel overnight to Cairo in an air-conditioned vehicle. Please note that this is a long-distance trip, and the drive between Hurghada and Cairo can take several hours each way, including rest stops and security checkpoints.

Upon arrival in Cairo, you will meet your professional tour guide. The guide language will be based on the language option selected when booking. The sightseeing program is planned with a clear structure and a comfortable pace, making it suitable for first-time visitors.

Visit the famous Giza Plateau, home to the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, the Pyramid of Menkaure, and the Great Sphinx. Your guide will explain the history of the site in an easy-to-follow way, with time for photos and questions. Entry to the Giza Plateau is included. Entry inside one of the pyramids is optional, available for an additional fee, and can be decided on the day according to the guest’s preference.

Continue to the Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, where you will explore highlights of ancient Egyptian civilization, including statues, treasures, and important royal artifacts. Guests may also have the option to choose the new Grand Egyptian Museum instead, depending on the selected option, availability, and the tour arrangement. Any museum upgrade or change may require an additional fee if it is not included in the booked option.

During the day, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Cairo. There may also be time for an optional Nile boat trip, available for an additional fee and based on the guest’s preference.

The tour may include free time or short stops for shopping at selected local stores, such as souvenir shops, perfume shops, papyrus galleries, or similar places. Purchases are completely optional, and guests are not required to buy anything.

After the sightseeing program, return by air-conditioned bus to Hurghada, with arrival back at your hotel expected late in the evening or at night, depending on traffic, road conditions, and hotel location.

This tour is ideal for travelers who want to visit Cairo’s main attractions in one day from Hurghada at a good value, while understanding that it involves a long round-trip journey by road.
highlights: Designed especially for first-time visitors to Egypt
Comfortable overnight travel by air-conditioned bus
Visit the Giza Pyramids and the Great Sphinx
Guided highlights tour of the Egyptian Museum
Excellent value Cairo experience from Hurghada

products.product_title: Hurghada: Luxor Karnak, Hatshepsut & the Valley of the Kings
products.short_description: Discover the wonders of ancient Egypt on a full-day trip from Hurghada to Luxor. Visit Karnak Temple, explore the Temple of Hatshepsut, and uncover the tombs at the Valley of the Kings.
products.product_description:
Full-Day Trip from Hurghada to Luxor

The trip starts early in the morning with pickup from the hotel in Hurghada by a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Guests then travel through the desert road toward Luxor. During the journey, there is a short rest stop of approximately 30 minutes, where guests can use the bathroom or have a light drink before continuing the drive to Luxor.

Upon arrival in Luxor, the tour guide will be waiting for the guests according to the language selected during booking. The tour begins with a visit to Karnak Temple, one of the largest and most important temple complexes in ancient Egypt. Guests will enjoy a guided explanation of the temple’s history, its massive columns, sacred halls, and impressive ancient architecture.

After visiting Karnak Temple, guests continue to the West Bank of Luxor. There are two options for crossing: guests may either continue by bus, or choose to cross by boat for an additional optional fee. If the boat option is selected, guests can enjoy a pleasant Nile boat trip for approximately 30 minutes.

After that, guests head to a local restaurant for lunch, then continue the tour toward the Valley of the Kings. On the way, there is a stop at the Colossi of Memnon for approximately 15 minutes, giving guests time to take photos and learn some historical information about the site.

At the Valley of the Kings, the package includes entrance to 3 tombs from the tombs open for visits. Guests also have the option, depending on their preference or pre-booked selection, to enter Tutankhamun’s Tomb or the Tomb of Ramses V and VI for an additional optional fee.

After finishing the visit to the Valley of the Kings, the tour continues toward the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. On the way, there is a rest stop of approximately 30 minutes at an alabaster or stone handicraft workshop, where guests are welcomed with a cold local drink. Guests will also have time to relax or use the bathroom.

The trip then continues to Hatshepsut Temple, a unique terraced temple set against the mountains and dedicated to one of the most famous queens in ancient Egyptian history.

At the end of the day, guests return comfortably to Hurghada by air-conditioned vehicle after enjoying a memorable day exploring the most important historical landmarks of Luxor.

visit to the Tomb of Tutankhamun or the Tomb of Ramses V & VI
Admire the magnificent Karnak Temple, the largest religious complex ever built
Visit the Temple of Hatshepsut, one of Egypt’s most remarkable architectural
Enjoy a small-group tour with an expert Egyptologist guide and lunch included

products.product_title: Luxor to Cairo: 2Day with Sleeper Train & Pyramids View Stay
products.short_description: Explore Cairo on a 2-day trip from Luxor. Travel by overnight train, visit the Pyramids of Giza, and stay in a luxury apartment with views of the Pyramids.
products.product_description:
Experience Cairo on this unforgettable 2-day journey from Luxor, combining ancient history, culture, and a unique overnight stay with breathtaking panoramic views of the Pyramids.

Day 1: Overnight Sleeper Train & Pyramids of Giza
Board the overnight sleeper train from Luxor to Cairo and enjoy a comfortable journey to Egypt’s vibrant capital. Upon arrival, head directly to the legendary Giza Plateau to explore the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and the iconic Great Sphinx. Continue to the spectacular Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), home to some of the world's most important ancient treasures.

Optional: Entry inside the Great Pyramid is available for an additional fee.

Later, check in to your luxury architectural apartment featuring a direct panoramic view of the Pyramids. In the evening, you may choose to join an optional Nile dinner cruise with live entertainment and traditional cuisine.

Day 2: Design Your Own Cairo Experience
After breakfast, enjoy a flexible day tailored to your interests. Accompanied by a professional guide, you may choose optional visits to Saqqara, Memphis, Dahshur, and the Citadel of Saladin, or explore Old Cairo and Islamic Cairo, including the Hanging Church, Amr Ibn Al-As Mosque, Khan El Khalili Bazaar, and the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization.

All visits on Day 2 are optional, allowing you complete freedom to customize your experience and pay only for the sites you wish to enter.

In the afternoon, transfer to the station for your return journey, taking home unforgettable memories of Cairo’s timeless wonders and spectacular pyramid views.

⚠️ Important Note: This tour does not necessarily start on the same day the booking is made. Once your booking is received, we will contact you to arrange the sleeper train tickets and confirm the exact departure date and time. The tour may start on the same day or the following day, depending on train availability and schedule, and will be coordinated with you directly.
